## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: The gen-eval scenario schema accepts signal_assertions, and the runner fails...

The system SHALL ensure that the gen-eval scenario schema accepts signal_assertions, and the runner fails a scenario whose signal deviates even when its outcome assertion passes.

#### Scenario: The gen-eval scenario schema accepts signal_assertions, and the runner fails...

WHEN `add-signal-assertions-to-gen-eval-regression-scenarios` is implemented
THEN The gen-eval scenario schema accepts signal_assertions, and the runner fails a scenario whose signal deviates even when its outcome assertion passes.

### Requirement: At least three existing converted regression scenarios are upgraded with...

The system SHALL ensure that at least three existing converted regression scenarios are upgraded with signal assertions and pass.

#### Scenario: At least three existing converted regression scenarios are upgraded with...

WHEN `add-signal-assertions-to-gen-eval-regression-scenarios` is implemented
THEN At least three existing converted regression scenarios are upgraded with signal assertions and pass.
